source.issueTitle: Feature: Add and Remove Products from Shopping Cart

acceptanceCriteria.title: Successful Login
acceptanceCriteria.description:
Given the user is on the login page,

When valid credentials are entered,

Then the products inventory page should be displayed.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Add Product to Cart
acceptanceCriteria.description:
Given the user is on the products inventory page,

When the user selects Add to cart for a product,

Then the selected product should be added to the shopping cart.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Update Cart Count
acceptanceCriteria.description:
Given a product has been added,

Then the shopping cart badge should display the correct item count.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Verify Cart Contents
acceptanceCriteria.description:
Given a product has been added,

When the user opens the shopping cart,

Then the cart should display the correct product name, quantity and price.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Remove Product
acceptanceCriteria.description:
Given the shopping cart contains a product,

When the user selects Remove,

Then the product should be removed from the cart.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Verify Empty Cart
acceptanceCriteria.description:
Given the product has been removed,

Then the shopping cart should contain no products and the cart badge should reflect the empty state.

generatedPlan.planTitle: Add and Remove Products from Shopping Cart Test Plan
generatedPlan.summary: Functional test plan covering user authentication, adding items to cart, verifying cart badge updates, inspecting cart contents, and removing items.

scenarios.title: Login and Add Product to Cart
scenarios.objective: Verify successful user login, adding a product to the cart, and updating the cart badge count.
preconditions: User is on the login page of SauceDemo.

steps.instruction: Enter standard username into Username field
Add Sauce Labs Backpack to cart

target.description: Add to cart button for Sauce Labs Backpack

steps.expectedObservation: Button text changes to Remove and cart badge shows count of 1.

assertions.explanation: Valid login redirects the user to the inventory page.

target.description: Remove button for Sauce Labs Backpack

assertions.explanation: Selecting Add to cart changes the button state to Remove, confirming item addition.
Shopping cart badge reflects 1 added item.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: User logs in successfully, adds a product to the cart, and cart badge updates to 1.

scenarios.title: Verify Cart Contents and Remove Product
scenarios.objective: Verify cart details for added product and ensure product removal updates cart state and badge properly.
preconditions: User is logged in and has added Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart.

steps.expectedObservation: Product name, price, and quantity are displayed.

steps.instruction: Click Remove button for Sauce Labs Backpack in cart
steps.expectedObservation: Product is removed from cart list and cart badge disappears.

assertions.explanation: The cart accurately displays the selected product name, quantity, and price.
Clicking Remove deletes the item from the cart.
Shopping cart badge is not displayed when the cart is empty.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Cart contains correct item details prior to removal, and becomes empty with no badge after item removal.
